title: Continuum hypothesis
scope: Does 2^aleph_0=aleph_1? Hilbert also asked whether the real numbers can be well ordered; that component follows from the axiom of choice in ZFC.
status_basis: The continuum hypothesis is independent of ZFC, assuming its consistency. The well-ordering component is a theorem of ZFC; the two claims must not share an undifferentiated open label.
